definitions.gloss: arrival and departure, coming and going
definitions.explanation: The combined concept of departing from and arriving at a location, typically used for transportation schedules and facilities.

examples.japanese: {発着|はっちゃく}{時刻|じこく}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: Check the arrival and departure times.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}の{発着|はっちゃく}ロビーで{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: We met at the airport's arrivals and departures lobby.

examples.japanese: この{駅|えき}は1{日|にち}500{本|ほん}の{列車|れっしゃ}が{発着|はっちゃく}する。
examples.english: 500 trains arrive and depart from this station daily.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{飛行機|ひこうき}の{発着|はっちゃく}に{遅|おく}れが{出|で}ている。
examples.english: Flights are experiencing delays in arrivals and departures due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {成田|なりた}{空港|くうこう}は{国際線|こくさいせん}の{発着|はっちゃく}{便数|びんすう}が{日本|にほん}で{最|もっと}も{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Narita Airport has the most international flight arrivals and departures in Japan.

notes:
FORMATION: {発|はつ} (departure) + {着|ちゃく} (arrival). A compound of opposites that together mean 'comings and goings.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{発着|はっちゃく}{時刻|じこく} (arrival/departure times)
・{発着|はっちゃく}{案内|あんない} (arrival/departure guide)
・{発着|はっちゃく}ロビー (arrivals/departures lobby)
・{発着|はっちゃく}{便|びん} (arriving/departing flights)

RELATED TERMS:
・{出発|しゅっぱつ} (departure)
・{到着|とうちゃく} (arrival)
・{発車|はっしゃ} (train departure)
